issue.title: Add Verse/Pericope Toggle to Mobile Settings
issue.body: Fluent Mobile currently has no way for a translator to switch recording granularity; the working unit is fixed at the project level. Web already exposes a verse/pericope toggle from Drafting onward, and this ticket adds the equivalent control to mobile Settings so a translator's mode choice becomes a live, per-user preference instead of a fixed project setting. ## Functional Requirements ### Settings — Verse/Pericope Toggle - Add a Verse / Pericope toggle control to the mobile Settings screen. - Selecting a value immediately updates the active display unit across the Bible tab and Record tab; no partial mode mixing. - Persist the toggle state as a per-user preference, not per-device. - Sync the preference to the translator's account when the device is online. > **Note:** The requirements doc doesn't specify the toggle's UI control type (switch vs. segmented control) or its exact placement within Settings — confirm before design/build. > **Note 2:** This ticket depends on the mobile pericope data model existing (tracked separately as an engineering-owned ticket).

comments.body:
**Test Results #407**

- Verse/Pericope Toggle in Settings – The Verse/Pericope toggle is available in the mobile Settings screen, and the user can select either option.
- Display Unit Update – Not Implemented – Selecting Pericope does not currently change the display unit in the Bible or Record tab. As discussed with Bernise, only the Settings toggle has been implemented at this stage; pericope display support in the Bible and Record tabs is not yet available.
- Follow-up Tickets – Follow-up tickets #409 and #408 have been created to implement the remaining pericope functionality. These changes will be tested once the tickets are moved to QA.
- Toggle Preference Persistence – The selected preference is retained after restarting the app and when the same user logs in again.


Moving this ticket to passedQA
